messages.plaintextBody:
Hi all,

A reminder that the next employment team CPD session is on Thursday 24 April, 12:30-13:30 in Meeting Room 5 (and on Teams). Counsel from Eldon Chambers will run through recent developments in whistleblowing detriment and dismissal. Sandwiches provided for those attending in person - please reply with any dietary requirements.

Donna
Practice Assistant
